title: Blind peer review result
description: The single object a lens returns. Same shape the CI path passes as submit_findings arguments; see contracts/shared_review_contract.md.

lens.description: The exact lens name the persona gives you, e.g. "Edge Cases".

summary.description: One short line. Not the findings.

findings.description: Use [] when you found nothing — a normal result, not a failure. Never null, never omitted.

location.description: A file:line that appears in the change you reviewed.
